title: Se puso malo
desc: A hospital corridor at eleven at night
setting: Chino's father-in-law was brought in at nine. There are eleven people in the corridor and nobody is leaving.

steps.speaker: Chino
steps.es: Ideay, vos. No tenías que venir.
steps.en: Ideay, you. You did not have to come.

options.en: I know. Here I am, then.
options.feedback: The exact answer. It refuses the excuse without making a speech out of showing up.

options.en: I wanted to see how you all were.
options.feedback: Warm and true. Slightly more explanation than the moment wants.

options.en: I came in case you needed anything.
options.feedback: Well meant, and it makes your being here conditional. It is not.

steps.speaker: Chino
steps.es: Está en cirugía. No sabemos nada todavía.
steps.en: He is in surgery. We do not know anything yet.

options.en: I will stay. Have you all eaten anything?
options.feedback: The two useful sentences in a corridor: I am staying, and food. Nobody in that hallway has eaten.

options.en: I hope it all goes well.
options.feedback: Kind, and it is what everyone else has already said four times.

options.es: Todo va a estar bien, ya vas a ver.
options.en: Everything is going to be fine, you will see.
options.feedback: You cannot know that, and he knows you cannot. It closes him down.

options.es: Voy a la esquina y traigo café para todos.
options.en: I will go to the corner and bring coffee for everybody.
options.feedback: Small, concrete, immediate. In a hospital corridor that is worth more than anything you could say.
True. Advice in a corridor is a job you have handed to somebody else.
Now nobody eats. You were the one person free to fix it.

steps.speaker: Chino
steps.es: Vos sos el único que no es de la familia aquí.
steps.en: You are the only one here who is not family.

options.es: Puede ser. Pero aquí estoy igual.
options.en: Maybe. But I am here all the same.
options.feedback: You did not argue with him and you did not leave. Both halves matter.
Light. He was not making conversation.
Claiming it out loud in that corridor is the one way to not be.
